summary: Wynn Resorts filed an 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results and declaring a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share, payable November 30, 2026 to holders of record November 16, 2026. Operating revenues fell to $1.69 billion from $1.83 billion year over year, net income attributable to Wynn was $17.3 million versus $88.3 million, diluted EPS was $0.17 versus $0.85, and Adjusted Property EBITDAR was $464.2 million versus $570.1 million. Management cited operational discipline and a Las Vegas hold rate outside the expected range. No special-situation event, advisor, or structural mechanic is present; no deal terms stated.
